mapper.select: SELECT X.MACHINENAME, X.ZONENAME, X.ACCESSMODE, X.INOUTTYPE, X.STATE, case when X.SUBPORTCNT < 2 then 2 else X.SUBPORTCNT end MAXCAPA, U.NAME PORTNAME, U.PORTTYPE, U.ACCEPTABLECARRIERTYPE, CASE WHEN U.BANNED='F' OR U.STATE='INSERVICE' THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END AVAILABILITY, X.FLOOR FROM NT_R_UNIT U, (SELECT M.TYPE AS EQPTYPE, M.STATE EQPSTATE, M.ACCEPTABLECARRIERTYPE, M.CARRIERTYPE, U.MACHINENAME, U.ZONENAME, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ACCESSMODE='AUTO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN ACCESSMODE='MANUAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'AUTO' ELSE 'MANUAL' END ACCESSMODE, MAX(CASE WHEN PORTTYPE='LP' THEN U.INOUTTYPE ELSE NULL END) INOUTTYPE, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN U.STATE!='INSERVICE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'OUTOFSERVICE' ELSE 'INSERVICE' END STATE, COUNT(*) as SUBPORTCNT, max(case when u.zonename like '4ABL%1F%' or u.name like '4ABL%1F%' then 1 when u.zonename like '4ABL%3F%' or u.name like '4ABL%3F%' then 3 when u.zonename like u.machinename||'%A_3_' then 3 when u.zonename like u.machinename||'%A_7_' then 7 when u.zonename like '4ALF%M_2_' then 3 when u.zonename like '4ALF%M_4_' then 7 else 3 end ) FLOOR FROM NT_R_UNIT U, NT_R_MACHINE M WHERE M.ID = U.MACHINENAME AND U.UNITKIND NOT IN ('shelf','vehicle') AND M.TYPE='STOCKER' AND M.ID NOT IN ('4ABL_M10','4AFC_M16') AND U.NAME NOT LIKE '%RM' AND U.NAME NOT LIKE '%FOUT' AND U.NAME NOT LIKE 'SEND%' AND U.NAME NOT LIKE '%F' GROUP BY M.TYPE, M.STATE , M.ACCEPTABLECARRIERTYPE, M.CARRIERTYPE, U.MACHINENAME, U.ZONENAME) X WHERE U.ZONENAME=X.ZONENAME AND U.NAME NOT LIKE '%FOUT' AND U.NAME NOT LIKE 'SEND%' AND U.NAME NOT LIKE '%F' ORDER BY X.MACHINENAME, X.ZONENAME, U.NAME

SELECT CNVMACHINENAME, CNVPORTGROUPNAME, CNVPORTNAME FROM ( SELECT U.MACHINENAME AS CNVMACHINENAME, CASE WHEN U.NAME LIKE '%1_' THEN SUBSTR(U.NAME, 1, 13) || 'G1' WHEN U.NAME LIKE '%2_' THEN SUBSTR(U.NAME, 1, 13) || 'G2' WHEN U.NAME LIKE '%8_' THEN SUBSTR(U.NAME, 1, 13) || 'G8' WHEN G.GROUPNAME IS NULL THEN 'ERR' ELSE G.GROUPNAME END AS CNVPORTGROUPNAME, U.NAME AS CNVPORTNAME FROM NT_R_UNIT U, NT_E_PORTGROUP G WHERE U.MACHINENAME IN ( SELECT ID FROM NT_R_MACHINE WHERE MACHINEKIND = 'interRail' AND STK_TYP = 'INTERAILSEMITS' ) AND U.MACHINENAME = G.MACHINENAME (+) AND U.NAME = G.PORTNAME (+) AND U.PORTTYPE = 'LP' AND U.NAME NOT LIKE '4AFC%G_' AND U.INOUTTYPE = 'OUT' ) WHERE CNVPORTGROUPNAME != 'ERR' ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

SELECT U.MACHINENAME, U.NAME, CASE WHEN U.BANNED='T' OR U.STATE !='INSERVICE' OR U.TRANSPORTUNITACCESSIBLE ='F' THEN 'F' ELSE 'T' END AVAILABILITY, CASE WHEN U.USERFREADER='T' THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END ISREADER, CASE WHEN N.ID IS NULL THEN 'F' ELSE 'T' END ISN2 FROM NT_R_UNIT U, NT_R_MACHINE M, NT_E_N2MACHINE N WHERE U.MACHINENAME=M.ID AND M.TYPE='STB' AND M.ID = N.MACHINENAME(+)

SELECT U.MACHINENAME, U.NAME, CASE WHEN U.BANNED='T' OR U.STATE !='INSERVICE' OR U.TRANSPORTUNITACCESSIBLE ='F' THEN 'F' ELSE 'T' END AVAILABILITY FROM NT_R_UNIT U, NT_R_MACHINE M WHERE U.MACHINENAME=M.ID AND M.MACHINEKIND='process' ORDER BY U.MACHINENAME, U.NAME

WITH T AS ( SELECT U.MACHINENAME, CASE WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN 'IN' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='BP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN 'IN' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='T' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN 'IN' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN 'OUT' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='BP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN 'OUT' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='T' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN 'OUT' ELSE U.NAME END GRPID, CASE WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN U.NAME WHEN U.PORTTYPE='BP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN NULL WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='T' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN NULL WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN U.NAME WHEN U.PORTTYPE='BP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN NULL WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='T' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN NULL ELSE U.NAME END GRPNAME, CASE WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN '1' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='BP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN '2' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='T' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN '3' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN '3' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='BP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN '2' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='T' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN '1' ELSE U.NAME END OD, U.NAME SUBPORT, U.ACCESSMODE, CASE WHEN U.BANNED='F' AND U.STATE='INSERVICE' THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END AVAILABLE, U.PORTTYPE FROM NT_R_UNIT U, NT_R_MACHINE M WHERE U.MACHINENAME=M.ID AND M.MACHINEKIND='interRail' AND M.KIND='INTERRAIL' AND (M.ID LIKE '_AIO%' OR M.ID LIKE '_ANC%') ) SELECT A.MACHINENAME, CASE WHEN A.GRPID NOT IN ('IN','OUT') THEN 'BOTH' ELSE A.GRPID END INOUTTYPE, A.PORTNAME, B.OD, B.SUBPORT, B.ACCESSMODE, A.AVAILABLE, B.PORTTYPE FROM ( SELECT MACHINENAME, GRPID, MAX(GRPNAME) PORTNAME, MAX(CASE WHEN GRPNAME IS NOT NULL THEN AVAILABLE ELSE NULL END) AVAILABLE FROM T GROUP BY MACHINENAME, GRPID ) A, T B WHERE A.MACHINENAME=B.MACHINENAME AND A.GRPID = B.GRPID ORDER BY A.MACHINENAME, B.GRPID, B.OD

SELECT MACHINENAME, NAME, CASE WHEN BANNED='F' AND STATE='INSERVICE' THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END AVAILABLE, CASE WHEN MACHINENAME LIKE '4ABL%' OR MACHINENAME LIKE '4AL%' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END MAXCAPA FROM NT_R_UNIT WHERE UNITKIND='crane' AND MACHINENAME NOT LIKE '%M10'

SELECT Z.MACHINENAME, Z.NAME, SUM(CASE WHEN U.STATE='INSERVICE' AND U.BANNED='F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) MAXCAPA, CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN U.STATE='INSERVICE' AND U.BANNED='F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) > 0 THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END AVAILABLE, NVL(NVL(MAX(P.PROCESSTYPELIST),MAX(MP.PROCESSTYPELIST)),'ALL') PROCESSTYPELIST FROM NT_R_ZONE Z, NT_R_MACHINE M, NT_R_UNIT U, (SELECT MACHINENAME, ZONENAME, LISTAGG(PROCESSTYPENAME,',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY PROCESSTYPENAME) PROCESSTYPELIST FROM NT_T_ZONEPROCESSTYPE GROUP BY MACHINENAME, ZONENAME) P, (SELECT MACHINENAME, LISTAGG(PROCESSTYPENAME,',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY PROCESSTYPENAME) PROCESSTYPELIST FROM NT_T_MACHINEPROCESSTYPE GROUP BY MACHINENAME) MP WHERE Z.MACHINENAME = M.ID AND M.MACHINEKIND='storage' AND M.TYPE='STOCKER' AND Z.TYPE='SHELF' AND U.ZONENAME=Z.NAME AND U.MACHINENAME=M.ID AND Z.MACHINENAME NOT LIKE '%M10' AND Z.MACHINENAME = P.MACHINENAME(+) AND Z.NAME=P.ZONENAME(+) AND Z.MACHINENAME = MP.MACHINENAME(+) GROUP BY Z.MACHINENAME, Z.NAME

SELECT M.ID, CASE WHEN M.TYPE='STB' THEN 'STBGROUP' WHEN M.TYPE='PROCESS' THEN 'EQP' WHEN M.TYPE='STOCKER' THEN 'STK' WHEN M.TYPE='CONVEYOR' AND (M.ID LIKE '4AIO%' OR M.ID LIKE '4ANC%') THEN 'FIO' ELSE M.TYPE END EQPTYPE, CASE WHEN N.MACHINENAME IS NULL THEN 'F' ELSE 'T' END ISN2, P.PROCESSTYPELIST, M.STK_TYP, DECODE(M.STATE,'INSERVICE','T','F') AVAILABLE, M.BAYNAME AS MCSBAYNM FROM NT_R_MACHINE M, NT_E_N2MACHINE N, (SELECT MACHINENAME, LISTAGG(PROCESSTYPENAME,',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY PROCESSTYPENAME) PROCESSTYPELIST FROM NT_T_MACHINEPROCESSTYPE GROUP BY MACHINENAME) P WHERE M.ID=N.MACHINENAME(+) AND M.ID=P.MACHINENAME(+) AND M.TYPE IN ('STB','PROCESS','STOCKER','CONVEYOR','OHT') AND (M.MACHINEKIND!='storage' OR M.HANDLETRANSPORTCOMMAND!='F') AND M.ID NOT LIKE '%\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND M.MACHINEKIND != 'interStorage' AND M.ID NOT IN ('INV001','TEST1234') ORDER BY 1

SELECT A.MACHINENAME || '_' || A.ALIASNAME AS ALIASNAME, A.MACHINENAME, A.UNITNAME FROM NT_R_UNITALIAS A where a.unitname not in ('4ABL_M10_OUT','4AFS6202_MO_FOUT','4AFC_M16_OUT') and unitname not like '%OUTG_' UNION ALL SELECT '4ABL_M10_OUT' aliasname, a.machinename, a.unitname from nt_r_unitalias A where a.unitname like '4ABL%A_OUT1F' UNION ALL SELECT '4ABL_M10_MOUT' aliasname, a.machinename, a.unitname from nt_r_unitalias A where a.unitname like '4ABL%M_OUT1F' UNION ALL SELECT '4AFS6202_MO_FOUT' aliasname, a.machinename, a.unitname from nt_r_unitalias A where a.unitname like '4AFS6202M_OUT%' union all select subgroupname||'_MOUT' as aliasname, machinename, unitname from nt_t_loadbalancegroup where subgroupname is not null union all select '4AFC_M16_OUT' as aliasname, machinename, name as unitname from nt_r_unit where regexp_like(name, '4AFC.*OUT8\d') union all select '4AFC_M14_OUT' as aliasname, machinename, name as unitname from nt_r_unit where regexp_like(name, '4AFC.*OUT[0-7]\d')

SELECT C.ID, C.MACHINENAME, CASE WHEN U.TYPE='SHELF' THEN U.ZONENAME ELSE C.UNITNAME END UNITNAME, C.LOTID, C.BATCHID, CASE WHEN REGEXP_INSTR(C.BATCH_SEQ,'^[+-]?\d*(\.?\d*)$') = 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(C.BATCH_SEQ) ELSE -1 END BATCH_SEQ, C.PROCESSID AS ROUTER, C.STEPID, CASE WHEN C.STATE = 'WAITIN' THEN 'WAIT_IN' WHEN C.STATE='WAITOUT' THEN 'WAIT_OUT' WHEN C.STATE='MOVING' THEN 'TRANSFERRING' WHEN C.STATE='PIOERR' THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE C.STATE END STATE, NVL(C.TYPE,'FOUP') TYPE, C.INSTALLTIME, C.N2_YN,--목적지가 N2일 경우 'N2'로 설정. 아니면 Null. 목적지에 도착하면 Clear됨 U.UNITKIND, J.JOB_ID, CASE WHEN J.JOB_STATE = 'TRANSFERRING' THEN 'PROCESSING' WHEN J.JOB_STATE = 'E84_ALTERNATED' THEN 'ALTERNATED' WHEN J.JOB_STATE = 'E84_ALTERNATING' THEN 'ALTERNATING' WHEN J.JOB_STATE IS NULL THEN 'NONE' WHEN j.JOB_STATE = 'CREATED' OR j.JOB_STATE = 'QUEUING' THEN 'QUEUED' ELSE J.JOB_STATE END AS JOB_STATE, J.SOURCEMACHINENAME, J.SOURCEUNITNAME, J.DESTMACHINENAME, J.DESTUNITNAME, J.JOB_CRT_TM, J.CREATOR, J.PRIORITY AS JOB_PRIORITY, CASE WHEN J.JOB_ID IS NOT NULL THEN C.DESTMACHINENAME ELSE NULL END FINAL_MES_EQP_ID, -- 타MCS간 반송일 경우 MES로 부터 받은 목적지를 넣어준다. CASE WHEN J.JOB_ID IS NOT NULL THEN C.DESTUNITNAME ELSE NULL END FINAL_MES_UNIT_ID, CASE WHEN CMD.TRANSPORTCOMMANDID IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CMD.TRANSPORTCOMMANDID||'-0' END AS CMD_ID, CMD.STATE AS CMD_STATE, CMD.TRANSPORTMACHINENAME AS CMD_TR_MACHINE, CMD.TRANSPORTUNITNAME AS CMD_TR_UNIT, CMD.FROMMACHINENAME AS CMD_FROM_MACHINE, CMD.FROMUNITNAME AS CMD_FROM_UNIT, CMD.TOMACHINENAME AS CMD_TO_MACHINE, CMD.TOUNITNAME AS CMD_TO_UNIT, CMD.CREATETIME AS CMD_CRT_TM, CMD.PRIORITY AS CMD_PRIORITY, CMD.CURRENTRETRYCOUNT AS RETRYCOUNT
FROM NT_M_CARRIER C, NT_R_UNIT U, ( SELECT J.CARRIERNAME, J.ID AS JOB_ID, J.STATE AS JOB_STATE, J.SOURCEMACHINENAME, CASE WHEN JSU.TYPE='SHELF' THEN JSU.ZONENAME ELSE J.SOURCEUNITNAME END SOURCEUNITNAME, J.DESTMACHINENAME, J.DESTUNITNAME, J.CREATETIME AS JOB_CRT_TM, J.CREATOR, J.PRIORITY FROM NT_T_TRANSPORTJOB J, NT_R_UNIT JSU WHERE J.SOURCEMACHINENAME = JSU.MACHINENAME(+) AND J.SOURCEUNITNAME= JSU.NAME(+) )J, (SELECT CO.TRANSPORTCOMMANDID, CO.CARRIERNAME, CO.STATE, CO.TRANSPORTMACHINENAME, CO.TRANSPORTUNITNAME, CO.FROMMACHINENAME, CASE WHEN CU.TYPE='SHELF' THEN CU.ZONENAME ELSE CU.NAME END FROMUNITNAME, CO.TOMACHINENAME, CO.TOUNITNAME, CO.CREATETIME, CO.PRIORITY, CO.CURRENTRETRYCOUNT FROM NT_T_TRANSPORTCMD CO, NT_R_UNIT CU WHERE CO.FROMUNITNAME = CU.NAME(+) AND CO.FROMMACHINENAME = CU.MACHINENAME(+) ) CMD WHERE C.MACHINENAME !='NA' AND C.STATE !='NA' and c.state != 'EVICTED' AND C.MACHINENAME=U.MACHINENAME AND C.UNITNAME = U.NAME AND C.ID = J.CARRIERNAME(+) AND C.ID = CMD.CARRIERNAME(+)

SELECT C.ID, C.MACHINENAME, CASE WHEN U.TYPE='SHELF' THEN U.ZONENAME ELSE C.UNITNAME END UNITNAME, C.LOTID, C.BATCHID, CASE WHEN REGEXP_INSTR(C.BATCH_SEQ,'^[+-]?\d*(\.?\d*)$') = 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(C.BATCH_SEQ) ELSE -1 END BATCH_SEQ, C.PROCESSID AS ROUTER, C.STEPID, CASE WHEN C.STATE = 'WAITIN' THEN 'WAIT_IN' WHEN C.STATE='WAITOUT' THEN 'WAIT_OUT' WHEN C.STATE='MOVING' THEN 'TRANSFERRING' WHEN C.STATE='PIOERR' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN C.STATE='NA' THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE C.STATE END STATE, NVL(C.TYPE,'FOUP') TYPE, C.INSTALLTIME, C.N2_YN,--목적지가 N2일 경우 'N2'로 설정. 아니면 Null. 목적지에 도착하면 Clear됨 U.UNITKIND, J.JOB_ID, CASE WHEN J.JOB_STATE = 'TRANSFERRING' THEN 'PROCESSING' WHEN J.JOB_STATE = 'E84_ALTERNATED' THEN 'ALTERNATED' WHEN J.JOB_STATE = 'E84_ALTERNATING' THEN 'ALTERNATING' WHEN J.JOB_STATE IS NULL THEN 'NONE' WHEN j.JOB_STATE = 'CREATED' OR j.JOB_STATE = 'QUEUING' THEN 'QUEUED' ELSE J.JOB_STATE END AS JOB_STATE, J.SOURCEMACHINENAME, J.SOURCEUNITNAME, J.DESTMACHINENAME, J.DESTUNITNAME, J.JOB_CRT_TM, J.CREATOR, J.PRIORITY AS JOB_PRIORITY, CASE WHEN J.JOB_ID IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(F.DESTMACHINENAME,C.DESTMACHINENAME) ELSE NULL END FINAL_MES_EQP_ID, -- 타MCS간 반송일 경우 MES로 부터 받은 목적지를 넣어준다. CASE WHEN J.JOB_ID IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(F.DESTUNITNAME,C.DESTUNITNAME) ELSE NULL END FINAL_MES_UNIT_ID, CASE WHEN CMD.TRANSPORTCOMMANDID IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CMD.TRANSPORTCOMMANDID||'-0' END AS CMD_ID, CMD.STATE AS CMD_STATE, CMD.TRANSPORTMACHINENAME AS CMD_TR_MACHINE, CMD.TRANSPORTUNITNAME AS CMD_TR_UNIT, CMD.FROMMACHINENAME AS CMD_FROM_MACHINE, CMD.FROMUNITNAME AS CMD_FROM_UNIT, CMD.TOMACHINENAME AS CMD_TO_MACHINE, CMD.TOUNITNAME AS CMD_TO_UNIT, CMD.CREATETIME AS CMD_CRT_TM, CMD.PRIORITY AS CMD_PRIORITY, CMD.CURRENTRETRYCOUNT AS RETRYCOUNT
FROM NT_M_CARRIER C, NT_R_UNIT U, ( SELECT J.CARRIERNAME, J.ID AS JOB_ID, J.STATE AS JOB_STATE, J.SOURCEMACHINENAME, CASE WHEN JSU.TYPE='SHELF' THEN JSU.ZONENAME ELSE J.SOURCEUNITNAME END SOURCEUNITNAME, J.DESTMACHINENAME, J.DESTUNITNAME, J.CREATETIME AS JOB_CRT_TM, J.CREATOR, J.PRIORITY FROM NT_T_TRANSPORTJOB J, NT_R_UNIT JSU WHERE J.SOURCEMACHINENAME = JSU.MACHINENAME(+) AND J.SOURCEUNITNAME= JSU.NAME(+) )J, (SELECT CO.TRANSPORTCOMMANDID, CO.CARRIERNAME, CO.STATE, CO.TRANSPORTMACHINENAME, CO.TRANSPORTUNITNAME, CO.FROMMACHINENAME, CASE WHEN CU.TYPE='SHELF' THEN CU.ZONENAME ELSE CU.NAME END FROMUNITNAME, CO.TOMACHINENAME, CO.TOUNITNAME, CO.CREATETIME, CO.PRIORITY, CO.CURRENTRETRYCOUNT FROM NT_T_TRANSPORTCMD CO, NT_R_UNIT CU WHERE CO.FROMUNITNAME = CU.NAME(+) AND CO.FROMMACHINENAME = CU.MACHINENAME(+) ) CMD, NT_F_FABTRANSPORTJOB F WHERE C.MACHINENAME !='NA' AND c.state != 'EVICTED' AND C.MACHINENAME=U.MACHINENAME AND C.UNITNAME = U.NAME AND C.ID = J.CARRIERNAME(+) AND C.ID = CMD.CARRIERNAME(+) AND C.ID = F.CARRIERNAME(+) AND C.ID = #{CARRIER_ID} AND C.ID IN (SELECT CARRIERNAME FROM NT_T_TRANSPORTJOB WHERE ID = #{JOB_ID}) AND C.ID IN (SELECT CARRIERNAME FROM NT_T_TRANSPORTCMD WHERE TRANSPORTUNITNAME = #{VHL_ID})

SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') EVENT_DT, 'M14' AS FROM_FAB_ID, 'M16' AS TO_FAB_ID, ID AS EQP_ID, 'CD_M14CNV' AS EQP_TYP, 'ALL' AS DET_AREA_TYP, 'STATE' AS DET_IDC_NM, CASE WHEN STATE = 'INSERVICE' AND CONNECTIONSTATE = 'CONNECTED' AND CONTROLSTATE = 'ONLINEREMOTE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS RSLT_VAL, 0 AS JUDGE_VAL FROM MACHINE_VW WHERE ID LIKE '4AFC%' AND HSMSREMOTEIP IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') EVENT_DT, 'M16' AS FROM_FAB_ID, 'M14' AS TO_FAB_ID, ID AS EQP_ID, 'CD_M14CNV' AS EQP_TYP, 'ALL' AS DET_AREA_TYP, 'STATE' AS DET_IDC_NM, CASE WHEN STATE = 'INSERVICE' AND CONNECTIONSTATE = 'CONNECTED' AND CONTROLSTATE = 'ONLINEREMOTE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS RSLT_VAL, 0 AS JUDGE_VAL FROM MACHINE_VW WHERE ID LIKE '4AFC%' AND HSMSREMOTEIP IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') EVENT_DT, 'M14' AS FROM_FAB_ID, 'M16' AS TO_FAB_ID, a.MACHINENAME AS EQP_ID, 'CD_M14CNV' AS EQP_TYP, 'CD_FOUP' AS DET_AREA_TYP, 'CD_FOUPM14M16' AS DET_IDC_NM, CASE WHEN b.MACHINENAME IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE b.CNT END AS RSLT_VAL, 0 AS JUDGE_VAL FROM ( SELECT '4AFC3201' AS MACHINENAME , 0 AS CNT FROM DUAL UNION SELECT '4AFC3301' AS MACHINENAME , 0 AS CNT FROM DUAL )A LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.MACHINENAME,COUNT(c.MACHINENAME) AS CNT FROM nt_m_carrier c LEFT JOIN nt_t_transportjob j ON c.id = j.carriername where (c.machinename like '4AFC%' and j.destmachinename like '4AFC%') or c.unitname like '4AFC3___A\_OUT%' escape '\' and unitname not in (select portname from nt_e_portgroup) GROUP BY MACHINENAME ORDER BY MACHINENAME ) B ON A.MACHINENAME = B.MACHINENAME
UNION
select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') EVENT_DT, 'M14' AS FROM_FAB_ID, 'M16' AS TO_FAB_ID, MACHINENAME AS EQP_ID, 'CD_M14CNV' AS EQP_TYP, 'CD_M14AAI' AS DET_AREA_TYP, 'CD_PORTINSERVICE' AS DET_IDC_NM , COUNT(CASE WHEN STATE = 'INSERVICE' and BANNED='F' THEN 1 END) RSLT_VAL, 0 AS JUDGE_VAL from nt_r_unit where machinename like '4AFC3%' and PORTTYPE='LP' and INOUTTYPE='IN' and name not like '%MI%'AND NAME IN ( SELECT UNITNAME FROM NT_T_INTRANODE WHERE TRANSPORTMACHINENAME = '4ACM4701') group by machinename
UNION
select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') EVENT_DT, 'M14' AS FROM_FAB_ID, 'M16' AS TO_FAB_ID, MACHINENAME AS EQP_ID, 'CD_M14CNV' AS EQP_TYP, 'CD_M14AAI' AS DET_AREA_TYP, 'CD_PORTTOTAL' AS DET_IDC_NM, COUNT(ID) RSLT_VAL, 0 AS JUDGE_VAL from nt_r_unit where machinename like '4AFC3%' and PORTTYPE='LP' and INOUTTYPE='IN' and name not like '%MI%'AND NAME IN ( SELECT UNITNAME FROM NT_T_INTRANODE WHERE TRANSPORTMACHINENAME = '4ACM4701') group by machinename
UNION
select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') EVENT_DT, 'M14' AS FROM_FAB_ID, 'M16' AS TO_FAB_ID, TOMACHINENAME AS EQP_ID, 'CD_M14CNV' AS EQP_TYP, 'CD_M14AAI' AS DET_AREA_TYP, 'CD_OHTCMD' AS DET_IDC_NM, count(TOMACHINENAME) as RSLT_VAL, 0 AS JUDGE_VAL from nt_t_transportcmd where transportmachinename='4ACM4701' and TOMACHINENAME like '4AFC3%' group by TOMACHINENAME
UNION
select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') EVENT_DT, 'M14' AS FROM_FAB_ID, 'M16' AS TO_FAB_ID, machinename AS EQP_ID, 'CD_M14CNV' AS EQP_TYP, 'CD_M14AAI' AS DET_AREA_TYP, 'CD_MAXCAPA' AS DET_IDC_NM, sum(MAXCAPACITY) as RSLT_VAL , 0 AS JUDGE_VAL from nt_r_unit WHERE MACHINENAME like '4AFC3%' AND PORTTYPE = 'LP' AND INOUTTYPE = 'IN' AND BANNED = 'F' AND state = 'INSERVICE' AND NAME IN ( SELECT UNITNAME FROM NT_T_INTRANODE WHERE TRANSPORTMACHINENAME = '4ACM4701') group by machinename
UNION
select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') EVENT_DT, 'M14' AS FROM_FAB_ID, 'M16' AS TO_FAB_ID, MACHINENAME AS EQP_ID, 'CD_M14CNV' AS EQP_TYP, 'CD_M16AAO' AS DET_AREA_TYP, 'CD_PORTINSERVICE' AS DET_IDC_NM , SUM(CNT_VAL) RSLT_VAL, 0 AS JUDGE_VAL FROM ( SELECT machinename, substr(name, - 2, 1) AS portnumber, CASE WHEN substr(name, - 2, 1) IN ( SELECT substr(name,-1) AS GROUPPORTNUMBER FROM nt_r_unit r WHERE r.machinename = machinename AND name LIKE '%A_OUTG%' and name LIKE '%8%' AND ( state = 'OUTOFSERVICE' OR banned = 'T' ) ) THEN 0 ELSE COUNT(CASE WHEN STATE = 'INSERVICE' and BANNED='F' THEN 1 END) END AS CNT_VAL from nt_r_unit where machinename like '4AFC3%' and PORTTYPE='LP' and INOUTTYPE='OUT' and ACCESSMODE='MANUAL' AND NAME IN ( SELECT UNITNAME FROM NT_T_INTRANODE WHERE TRANSPORTMACHINENAME = '4AFC_CNV') group by machinename ,name ) GROUP BY machinename
UNION
select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') EVENT_DT, 'M14' AS FROM_FAB_ID, 'M16' AS TO_FAB_ID, MACHINENAME AS EQP_ID, 'CD_M14CNV' AS EQP_TYP, 'CD_M16AAO' AS DET_AREA_TYP, 'CD_PORTTOTAL' AS DET_IDC_NM, COUNT(ID) RSLT_VAL, 0 AS JUDGE_VAL from nt_r_unit where machinename like '4AFC3%' and PORTTYPE='LP' and INOUTTYPE='OUT' and ACCESSMODE='MANUAL' AND NAME IN ( SELECT UNITNAME FROM NT_T_INTRANODE WHERE TRANSPORTMACHINENAME = '4AFC_CNV') group by machinename
UNION
SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') EVENT_DT, 'M16' AS FROM_FAB_ID, 'M14' AS TO_FAB_ID, a.MACHINENAME AS EQP_ID, 'CD_M14CNV' AS EQP_TYP, 'CD_FOUP' AS DET_AREA_TYP, 'CD_FOUPM16M14' AS DET_IDC_NM, CASE WHEN b.MACHINENAME IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE b.CNT END AS RSLT_VAL , 0 AS JUDGE_VAL FROM ( SELECT '4AFC3201' AS MACHINENAME , 0 AS CNT FROM DUAL UNION SELECT '4AFC3301' AS MACHINENAME , 0 AS CNT FROM DUAL )A LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.MACHINENAME,COUNT(c.MACHINENAME) AS CNT FROM nt_m_carrier c LEFT JOIN nt_t_transportjob j ON c.id = j.carriername where (c.machinename like '4AFC%' and j.destmachinename not like '4AFC%') GROUP BY MACHINENAME ORDER BY MACHINENAME ) B ON A.MACHINENAME = B.MACHINENAME
UNION
select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') EVENT_DT, 'M16' AS FROM_FAB_ID, 'M14' AS TO_FAB_ID, MACHINENAME AS EQP_ID, 'CD_M14CNV' AS EQP_TYP, 'CD_M16AAI' AS DET_AREA_TYP, 'CD_PORTINSERVICE' AS DET_IDC_NM, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATE = 'INSERVICE' and BANNED='F' THEN 1 END) RSLT_VAL, 0 AS JUDGE_VAL from nt_r_unit where machinename like '4AFC3%' and PORTTYPE='LP' and INOUTTYPE='IN' and name not like '%MI%'AND NAME IN ( SELECT UNITNAME FROM NT_T_INTRANODE WHERE TRANSPORTMACHINENAME = '4AFC_CNV') group by machinename
UNION
select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') EVENT_DT, 'M16' AS FROM_FAB_ID, 'M14' AS TO_FAB_ID, MACHINENAME AS EQP_ID, 'CD_M14CNV' AS EQP_TYP, 'CD_M16AAI' AS DET_AREA_TYP, 'CD_PORTTOTAL' AS DET_IDC_NM, COUNT(NAME) RSLT_VAL, 0 AS JUDGE_VAL from nt_r_unit where machinename like '4AFC3%' and PORTTYPE='LP' and INOUTTYPE='IN' and name not like '%MI%'AND NAME IN ( SELECT UNITNAME FROM NT_T_INTRANODE WHERE TRANSPORTMACHINENAME = '4AFC_CNV') group by machinename
UNION
SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') EVENT_DT, 'M16' AS FROM_FAB_ID, 'M14' AS TO_FAB_ID, MACHINENAME AS EQP_ID, 'CD_M14CNV' AS EQP_TYP, 'CD_M14AAO' AS DET_AREA_TYP, 'CD_PORTINSERVICE' AS DET_IDC_NM, SUM( CASE WHEN f.map_number IN ( SELECT substr(name,-1) AS GROUPPORTNUMBER FROM nt_r_unit r WHERE f.machinename = r.machinename AND name LIKE '%A_OUTG%' and name NOT LIKE '%8%' AND ( state = 'OUTOFSERVICE' OR banned = 'T' ) ) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN state = 'INSERVICE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END
) RSLT_VAL, 0 AS JUDGE_VAL FROM ( SELECT machinename, NAME, STATE, CASE WHEN NAME IN ('4AFC3201A_OUT11', '4AFC3201A_OUT12', '4AFC3201A_OUT13', '4AFC3201A_OUT14', '4AFC3201A_OUT15', '4AFC3201A_OUT16', '4AFC3201A_OUT17', '4AFC3201A_OUT18', '4AFC3201A_OUT19', '4AFC3201A_OUT20', '4AFC3201A_OUT21', '4AFC3201A_OUT22', '4AFC3201A_OUT23', '4AFC3201A_OUT24', '4AFC3301A_OUT01', '4AFC3301A_OUT02', '4AFC3301A_OUT03', '4AFC3301A_OUT04') THEN 1 WHEN NAME IN ('4AFC3201A_OUT31', '4AFC3201A_OUT32', '4AFC3201A_OUT33', '4AFC3201A_OUT34', '4AFC3201A_OUT35', '4AFC3201A_OUT36', '4AFC3201A_OUT37', '4AFC3201A_OUT38', '4AFC3301A_OUT11', '4AFC3301A_OUT12', '4AFC3301A_OUT13', '4AFC3301A_OUT14', '4AFC3301A_OUT15', '4AFC3301A_OUT16', '4AFC3301A_OUT17', '4AFC3301A_OUT18', '4AFC3301A_OUT19', '4AFC3301A_OUT20', '4AFC3301A_OUT21', '4AFC3301A_OUT22', '4AFC3301A_OUT23', '4AFC3301A_OUT24' ) THEN 2 WHEN NAME IN ('4AFC3301A_OUT31', '4AFC3301A_OUT32', '4AFC3301A_OUT33', '4AFC3301A_OUT34' ) THEN 3 WHEN NAME IN ('4AFC3301A_OUT35', '4AFC3301A_OUT36', '4AFC3301A_OUT37', '4AFC3301A_OUT38' ) THEN 4 WHEN NAME IN ('4AFC3301A_OUT41', '4AFC3301A_OUT42', '4AFC3301A_OUT43', '4AFC3301A_OUT44' ) THEN 5 WHEN NAME IN ('4AFC3301A_OUT51', '4AFC3301A_OUT52', '4AFC3301A_OUT53', '4AFC3301A_OUT54' ) THEN 6 WHEN NAME IN ('4AFC3301A_OUT55', '4AFC3301A_OUT56', '4AFC3301A_OUT57', '4AFC3301A_OUT58' ) THEN 7 ELSE 8 END AS MAP_NUMBER FROM nt_r_unit WHERE machinename LIKE '4AFC3%' AND porttype = 'LP' AND inouttype = 'OUT' AND accessmode = 'MANUAL' AND name IN ( SELECT unitname FROM nt_t_intranode WHERE transportmachinename = '4ACM4701' ) ) f GROUP BY MACHINENAME
UNION

select TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') EVENT_DT, 'M14' AS FROM_FAB_ID, 'M16' AS TO_FAB_ID, U.NAME AS EQP_ID, 'CD_M14CNV' AS EQP_TYP, 'CD_M14AAI' AS DET_AREA_TYP, 'CD_ZT10MININPUT' AS DET_IDC_NM, ROUND((U.USED/T.TOTAL)*100) AS RSLT_VAL , 0 AS JUDGE_VAL from ( --사용중 포트수 select a.name, COALESCE(b.cnt, 0) as USED from ( select name from nt_r_machine where name IN ('4AFC3201','4AFC3301') ) a left join ( select machinename, count(*) as cnt from nt_m_carrier where unitname in ( select name from nt_r_unit where machinename IN ('4AFC3201','4AFC3301') and inouttype = 'IN' and name not like '%IN8%' and accessmode = 'AUTO' and porttype = 'LP' ) group by machinename ) b on a.name=b.machinename) U, ( --전체 포트수 select machinename, count(*) as TOTAL from nt_r_unit where machinename IN ('4AFC3201','4AFC3301') and inouttype = 'IN' and accessmode = 'AUTO' and name not like '%IN8' and porttype = 'LP' group by machinename ) T WHERE U.NAME = T.MACHINENAME

SELECT 'CD_M14LFT' AS EQP_TYP, ROUND( (COUNT(MACHINENAME) - COUNT(CASE WHEN STATE = 'INSERVICE' AND BANNED = 'F' THEN 1 END)) / COUNT(MACHINENAME) * 100, 2 ) AS PORT_DOWN_RATE FROM nt_r_unit where machinename like '4ABL33%' and PORTTYPE='LP' and name not like '%MI%' and name not like '%MO%' and name not like '%M_IN%' and name not like '%M_OUT%' and name not like '%OUT%F'
